g.text: toobur-veryfit-research
Reverse-engineering workspace for IDO / VeryFit watches sold as TOOBUR: three ways to capture BLE bytes, one canonical command map, and a test-fixture pipeline that feeds the Gadgetbridge driver.
Entry points
Core
State
External
`README.md` · the map: protocol reference first, then build and install, then probe usage
`scripts/toobur_*.py` · live probe, v3 sync smoke, bind, dial, OTA, recover, bulk and bruteforce sweeps
`htmlapp/*.html` · standalone Web Bluetooth panels, `confirmed-only.html` alone is 258 KB
`gadgetbridge/` · nested checkout of the working fork, 62 dirty files, its commits never leave that folder
`A200-PROTOCOL.md` · canonical wire command map, bruteforce and logcat backed, supersedes the scattered tables in `TOOBUR.md`
`LATEST_SYNC_PARSING.md` · the v3 `0x05` then `0x04` route, save offsets, field layouts
`docs/*.md` · 14 topic notes: watch faces, OTA, dial commands, screen payloads, a recovery incident
`scripts/toobur_v3_sync.py` · pure builders and parsers: 137-byte `0x05`, per-type `0x04`, CRC16, channel guessed above 50 bytes
feature confirmation · logcat or probe hex becomes a fixture, a JUnit test, a `@ConfirmedFeature`, then a registry row
`packetdumps/` · logcat, live, synthetic, btsnoop and extracted captures
`docs/confirmed-features.md` plus issues 001-020 and `bruteforce_results.txt`
`func-tables/function_table.json` · capability bits lifted out of firmware
`session-ses_f230.md` at 335 KB, `skills-lock.json`, `ralph/` · agent-run artifacts, not protocol truth
TOOBUR A200 over BLE · BlueZ D-Bus on Linux, Bleak when installed, the MAC defaults to the test unit
Android phone · adb logcat of VeryFit, or of the Gadgetbridge build under test
Chrome Web Bluetooth · where the `htmlapp` experiments run
`d3nd3/gadgetbridge-veryfit` · where the driver, fixtures and migrations land
captures and questions
notes, fixtures, registry rows
BLE + logcat
